notes: DCAToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 DCA once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. Transfers have no fee, and there are no external minting or administrative functions. No application contracts are deployed. The pool initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
